id.description: Numbered task ID (e.g. t0042). Set by the CLI at create time; do not edit.

kind.description: Kind discriminator. Always 'task' for this schema.

name.description: Slug portion of the file stem (no id prefix). Lowercase, hyphenated.

created.description: Date the task was created (YYYY-MM-DD). Set by the CLI; do not edit.

started.description: Date or datetime when the task moved to in-progress. Written by the harness on transition.

completed.description: Date or datetime when the task reached done. Written by the harness on transition.

type.description: Task category. Closed enum: well-known finite set; new categories require a schema bump (intentional, supports schema-derived tooling).

priority.description: Priority hint. Closed enum: small, stable vocabulary. Optional; omit when 'normal'.

assignee.description: Agent or person assigned to work on this task. Free-form because the agent roster is dynamic. Empty string for unassigned backlog tasks.

owner.description: Agent or person who owns/verifies this task. Free-form because owners include both agents and humans (e.g. 'user').

parent.description: Wikilink to the umbrella task when this is a sub-task.

subtasks.description: Wikilinks to child tasks. Mirrors the ## Subtasks table in the body for type:feature umbrellas.

depends_on.description: Wikilinks to tasks that must reach done before this one is promoted to ready.

artifacts.description: Wikilinks to documentation outputs produced during execution (specs, research, agent specs, notes). Never source code paths.
